acquisition method: Data dependent LC–MS/MS analysis of phosphopeptides enriched by IAP was performed
cleavage agent: digested with 1 mg/mL TPCK-treated trypsin on an orbital shaker at 25 °C overnight
collision energy: 35% normalized collision energy and activation time of 0.1 ms
enrichment method: phosphotyrosine peptides were enriched using anti-phosphotyrosine antibody (pY100)
fractionation method: Peptides were than fractionated across a 90-min linear reversed phase HPLC gradient (from 5 to 60% Acetonitrile)
fragmentation method: selected for high energy collision dissociation fragmentation
instrument: performed with an LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: employed a stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) strategy to label invasive breast cancer cells
mass analyzer: High-resolution MS/MS spectra were acquired (at 15,000 resolution at 400 m/z) on the Orbitrap analyzer following fragmentation
ptm: fixed modification of carbamidomethylation; variable modifications of N-terminal acetylation, oxidation at methionine, phosphorylation at serine, threonine and tyrosine and SILAC labeling 13C6,15N2-lysine; 2H4-lysine; 13C6-arginine and 13C6,15N2-arginine

The search parameters were as follows: a maximum of one missed cleavage; a fixed modification of carbamidomethylation; variable modifications of N-terminal acetylation, oxidation at methionine, phosphorylation at serine, threonine and tyrosine and SILAC labeling 13C6,15N2-lysine; 2H4-lysine; 13C6-arginine and 13C6,15N2-arginine
